cs.t: I have the wired Microsoft keyboard and it is fabulous. I switched to the wireless Logitech keyboard and it is terrible for productivity. It's like those Dell/HP keyboards where the keys are smaller and crammed closer together. It also doesn't have much of a curve to it. I would not buy it again nor would I recommend it, but the Microsoft keyboard is a definite winner.
cs.th: Ask HN: What ergonomic keyboard/mouse do you recommend?
